==Quest==
===Bring the Necronomicon===
[[Snake]] failed the summoning. He needs you to get the original summoning book, the [[Necronomicon]], from the [[Astrologer]]. Speak to the [[Astrologer]] and he'll say that he gave it to the [[Lighthouse Keeper]]. Speak to the [[Lighthouse Keeper]] and give him 5 [[Maggot|Maggots]] in exchange for the [[Necronomicon]]. Return to Snake for 10 {{Happiness}}. In Stranger Sins you learn that [[Clotho]] ordered [[Dig]] to write it so she could enact vengeance upon the townspeople.
